# Cedarmont Farm (concept by Kerblabs)

> 40-acre private estate wedding venue in Franklin, Tennessee, 20 minutes from Nashville. Facts from cedarmontfarm.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Phone: 615-682-1815
- Instagram: @cedarmontfarm
- Showings: by appointment

## Offerings
- All-inclusive wedding packages
- Ceremony and reception venues, indoor and outdoor
- Day-of coordination, design guidance and personalization
- Film and photo location services

## Spaces
- Event barn, historic 1815 home, bridal house, pond, pool and flagstone deck

## FAQ
- Prices? Listed on their weddings page, not reproduced here.
